payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of the three layers of the annotation scheme used in the OLID dataset.

claims.text: The three layers of the annotation scheme are: (A) whether the language is offensive or not, (B) the type of offensive language, and (C) the target of the offensive language.
Layer A categorizes language as offensive or not, Layer B identifies the type of offensive language, and Layer C categorizes the targets of insults and threats.
Layer C further categorizes targets into individual (IND), group (GRP), and other (OTH).
